messages:
hazel: deploy-bot kicked off staged rollout v3.0.0 -> canary 7% (regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1). change window until 04:00 UTC. please watch /v1/generate function-calling paths :eyes:
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started: v3.0.0 -> canary=7% | regions=[us-east-1, eu-west-1] | CL#5120
kofi: getting a cluster of client-reported 422s on function calls routed to canary. started at ~t+3m, ~0.6% of traffic but user-facing errors
api-bot: proxy sample: 422 invalid params -> request_id=req-9a8b | trace: https://telemetry.redwood/req-9a8b
priya: this build included the function-calling wire change (snake_case -> camelCase) per CL#5109. we intended to deploy a compat shim later but didn't land it in time
kofi: so clients are sending snake_case and canary expects camelCase -> validation fails. ops: can we hold? this is breaking client integrations
hazel: hold progression and circuit-break further percent increases. @deploy-bot freeze and add changelog note: "hold: function-calling schema mismatch causing 422s on canary"
deploy-bot: action queued: freeze rollout progression. canary remains at 7%. notifications sent to #devex #support #eng-releases
priya: mitigation options: (1) revert wire change in runtime (fast rollback CL#5121), (2) deploy compat shim accepting both cases (CL#5122), (3) route affected routes away from canary temporarily
kofi: my vote is revert (CL#5121) as fastest path to restore client behavior, then follow up with compat shim in v3.0.1
hazel: +1 to revert. Priya, can you prepare CL#5121 and get a quick build for canary redeploy? ETA ~10m
priya: on it. will run function-calling integration suite against canary after deploy. smoke command: ```./integration_tests --suite=function_calling --env=canary```
hazel: support, please prep a customer-facing note template in case customers ask; mark this as incident_candidate and keep this thread for updates
deploy-bot: note recorded: incident_candidate=true | changelog_note_added=true
priya: CL#5121 merged and build started. will post when image deployed
hazel: thanks. consensus: hold at 7%, revert hotfix CL#5121, QA validate, then resume ramp if green. tagging for postmortem if rollback required.
